title: 硬币与仙人掌 (Coins & Wishpalm)
description:
Contact us.This is an RPG game infused with Rogue elements 

but the focus of the game is not on adventure and combat

but rather on non-combat "leisure gameplay."

The game can be broadly described as:After slaying monsters, treasure hunting, and gathering in the wild, players return to town to experience a variety of non-combat activities such as trading, tactical board games, card games, auctions, stone gambling, and tabletop games.

Об игреYou are a hero with a limited lifespan to fight, risk death, discover treasures, invest, and place bets. You reflect on your journey from 'Novice' to 'Veteran.' The honors and items obtained in each life can be passed on to the next life.

Strongly recommended:

1.Watch the beginner tutorial at least once.2.Be sure to read the text instructions in all gameplay scenarios.

This is an open world indie adventure game with fate as its starting point >>>>>>

 "Coins" and "Wishpalm" are two important game features that influence the game progression.

Various "coins" as extremely rare dropped items, have special effects including, but not limited to:

random teleport / rewards / storage function / rebirth and dozens of other effects.

"Wishpalm" is the manifestation of wish rules in the world, including 100+ various wish effects, where you can gain extra rewards through your choices.

In the game, you can freely choose your preferred way to play, and you can engage in trade between towns.
Gather resources to forge powerful weapons, explore the world to achieve honor, and the game includes a variety of gameplay modes.

You can equip any type and any number of equipment at the same time. If you wish, you can even wear 10 rings at once.
The experience gained by characters is no longer a mere numerical value. Players will write their own [Experience Notes], which can not only increase levels but also be sold to those in need.
Luck, as a component of various game mechanics, is no longer limited to passively increasing numbers. When you are "blessed with good fortune," you will gain unexpected effects. 
Spirit Stone"serve not only as a form of currency in the game but also as a raw material used for crafting various items.
Once a character dies, their age limit will be deducted as a penalty. When a character's age exceeds the limit, the character will "die permanently." Players must start over but have the option to retain some resources for a new character.The game has five difficulty levels, which players can choose according to their actual gameplay experience. Through multiple attempts and learning, they can gradually master the game rules and challenges.There are two interrelated financial systems: Spirit Stones and Colored Chips, both of which need to be obtained by the players within the game.Collect various resources, including mining, herb gathering, fishing, and logging.You will play as a novice knight, a profession that serves as a rank certification. As a knight, you can use any weapon at your disposal to fight.The game includes: • 900+ combat items

• 50+ potion items

• 200+ spell/book items

• 140+ food items

• 120+ raw material items

• 500+ high-value items with commercial value

• 200+ uncategorized items

• A total of not less than 2000+ items of various types

• Players have 150+ usable skills

• Enemies have 40+ different racial traits

• There are 100+ different types of enemies in the game

• 200+ achievable honor events (achievements) (may continue to be updated after the game is released)

• There are 7 types of terrain in the wilderness

• Dozens of randomly occurring mission events

• One non-mandatory main quest

• Players can freely choose whether to increase their rank, and the number of weapons they can equip

• There are 20+ non-combat gameplay modes that can be deeply explored
